description: Correct a ticket's attendee details — name, email, company, phone, tags or metadata. Only the fields you pass are sent, and no email is sent to anyone (unlike a reassignment, which this server does not do). Tito: PATCH /:account/:event/tickets/:ticket_slug.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

name: tito_update_ticket
title: Update a ticket's attendee details
